title: feat: land community publisher icons with rendering fixes
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Lands @tomdacatto’s publisher icons from #14734 with the rendering fixes from tomdacatto/pollinations#3, updated against main.
- Keeps one media URL field and the existing storage/catalog paths. Fixes overlapping icons and solid-square backgrounds; removes redundant intermediate validation.
- Squash merge with Tom credited as co-author. His agreed 5-Pollen reward will be recorded directly for quest #14837 because this integration PR has a different author.
- No upload UI, new credentials, or production promotion. Focused tests, both worker typechecks, Enter build, and Biome pass; CI reruns after the main update.

gist.headline: Publishers get their faces back
gist.blurb: Community publishers can now bring their own little flags to the model garden. Icons render cleanly in the catalog instead of piling up or arriving as mysterious solid squares.
gist.summary: Added a single `icon_url` media field for community providers and rendered publisher icons across the Community Endpoints view and model catalog, with fixes for overlapping icons and opaque square backgrounds.
gist.impact: Users browsing community models now see each publisher’s icon displayed cleanly in catalog rows and endpoint profiles, making provenance easier to spot at a glance.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the community model catalog as a cozy garden bulletin board where distinct publisher-icon tiles are neatly planted and no longer overlap or have solid background blocks. Polli, wearing a tiny curator beret, carefully hangs a clean icon plaque while a helpful CRT monitor robot admires the organized provider garden; include flowers and code-plants to connect the catalog to the hive.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art community model garden with neatly spaced publisher-icon plaques on a warm cream catalog board, each tile cleanly framed instead of overlapping, surrounded by small flowers and code-plants glowing lime green (#ecf874). The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny curator beret and carefully straightens an icon plaque while a cute CRT-monitor robot watches happily. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle CRT glow, nostalgic but beautiful.
